prog='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    noise=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    fig=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (0,noise)]
    col=g[fig[0][0]][fig[0][1]]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in fig); c0=min(j for _,j in fig)
    fh=max(i for i,_ in fig)-r0+1; fw=max(j for _,j in fig)-c0+1
    figset={(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in fig}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h-fh+1):
        for j in range(w-fw+1):
            if all(g[i+a][j+b]==0 for a,b in figset):
                for a,b in figset: out[i+a][j+b]=col
    return out
'''
